evidence_method: Completed 80-request structured and 84-request boundary audits plus focused repairs (16 tool, 16 thinking, 8 stop replay requests) and 6 additional chat/hint checks. Not a single final-source all-green run.
checks: All merged bodies re-extracted; actual MTP path/algorithm, nonzero proposals/cycles, counter sums, generated IDs and usage checked. No AR fallback counted.
All 82 blocking/SSE comparisons recomputed; random tool-call IDs ignored, names/arguments compared exactly.
All 16 hard-thinking rows use repaired queue policy and tokenizer-derived close IDs [248069]; phase, cap, forced close position and answer counters rechecked.
Required/automatic tool logprobs validated as raw model tool syntax, not probabilities of reserialized JSON. Selected/top bytes and finite probabilities checked.
Stops test English/Japanese multi-token strings; alternate EOS termination, min_tokens masking, and ignore_eos continuing through alternate EOS tested at greedy and sampled temperatures.
Eight no-logprob stop SSE repair rows match original blocking text, IDs, finish details and usage. Chat has two additional stop blocking/SSE pairs.
Explicit per-request hint override reports prompt_hint_only and does not force hard closure.
limitations: C1 text functional controls only, not semantic tool quality or full production qualification.
SSE is buffered. Nonempty stop strings also buffer AR to prevent in-context BPE mismatch leaking text; incremental filtering and disconnect/backpressure publication remain task20.
When standalone stop tokenization differs from in-context tokens, final text is trimmed before publication but generation may run to its token limit; canonical usage counts all generated tokens.

Original structured report marked all rows passed despite weak hard-cap assertions and failed tool comparisons. All 16 hard-thinking rows and all 16 affected tool rows replaced with repaired-source evidence.

No full category-suite quality/performance claim from these deterministic constrained functional fixtures. Production numerical, task, concurrency, multimodal and automatic-selection gates remain open.

focused_replay_input.construction: Original structured report with all 16 hard_thinking rows marked for replay and comparisons cleared; derived selection input, not new execution.
